title: OrderCreated
description: Trigger: published by the REST API Service's POST /api/orders (Design.md §13 Step I5) as a raw, opaque pass-through of the request body — this schema is the Database Adapter's own contract for what it expects to find inside that body (Step J4), not enforced by the REST API Service itself. orderId is caller-supplied (Decision #25), not a DB-assigned id, so the write path can upsert idempotently without a round trip back through the bus first. `orders` is still a placeholder bounded context (Decision #14) — real schemas replace this whenever a real domain does.

orderId.description: Caller-supplied primary key for the orders table (Decision #25).

item.description: Placeholder business column — infra/mysql/init.sql's demo orders table.

quantity.description: Placeholder business column; defaults to 1 if omitted.
